C31.value: Important Note on Downstream Ecosystem Governance

C32.value: For downstream new hardware backends, all of their platform-exclusive tests must be fully hosted and maintained by the respective vendors within their own downstream repositories

C35.value: - Precise Mapping: Solves the conflict between step-by-step backend development and scattered tests. Connects features directly to test cases—no more "needle-in-a-haystack" hunting.

C36.value: - Massive Compute Savings: Eliminates the need for downstream backends to run all PyTorch tests. Vendors focus solely on agnostic/, while core/ is fully offloaded to upstream CI, drastically cutting compute costs.

C37.value: - Automated CI Auditing: Enables easy workflow linting rules:

C38.value: - test/core/: Strictly bans instantiate_device_type_tests() and device keywords.

C39.value: - test/agnostic/: Mandates instantiate_device_type_tests() and the device parameter for all tests.

C42.value: - Decoupled Execution: Directory migration will NOT run concurrently with code refactoring to prevent massive merge conflicts.

C43.value: - Module-by-Module Move: Migration happens per module. Once a module's file-level refactoring is done, we will schedule a one-time file move. Since this involves file paths only, it is exceptionally low-risk and easy to land.
